gtfsIdentity.currentPassengerAccessReview: The current Tosaden airport access diagram dated 2026-02-01 labels the exact airport-feed 高知橋 alighting point (3903_01) west of the national-road/tram corridor and the boarding point (3903_02) east of it. OSM current raw response (ODbL 1.0; 2026-10-04) supplies a topologically connected public route: west roadside sidewalk way 556416252 → signalized crossing way 556416254 → east roadside sidewalk way 602443312. The sidewalk/crossing ways share exact OSM node 5367549782 at the west junction and node 5722293791 at the east junction; the crossing way includes exact vertices on both carriageway ways and the tram crossing. Bind only a coarse public path between the separately admitted native stops, using the operator map for directional-side semantics and the OSM way graph for the continuous public path. Do not merge stops, use straight-line joins, infer exact curb nodes, copy map geometry, or assert accessibility or travel time.
